newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES TUMBLE ON FULL RESERVES.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES TUMBLE ON FULL RESERVES.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates tumbled on Tuesday as banks offloaded funds on the first day of a new reserve period.
The rates finished at 18.00 percent after opening at 22.25.

"It's a very liquid market and now we're at the bottom," said Janos Mihalik of Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank. "Rates have fallen to only half a point above the central bank's overnight reverse repo rate."
Dealers said the banks expected a tight market this week and overfilled their reserves on Friday.--Budapest +361 3274040
